findings.rationale: PostgreSQL has no DECODE(); it is a CASE expression. DECODE also treats NULL as equal to NULL, which CASE x WHEN NULL never does.
findings.fix_hint: CASE expr WHEN s1 THEN r1 ... ELSE default END; use CASE WHEN expr IS NULL ... for a NULL search value
